title: JSON
goal: Exchange structured data using a text format.
explanation: JSON is text with a restricted syntax. Object keys and string values use double quotes. Comments, functions, undefined and trailing commas are not part of JSON.
JSON.parse turns JSON text into a JavaScript value. JSON.stringify serialises supported values to JSON text. Dates need an agreed representation, often an ISO string.
Parsing proves only that the syntax is valid. Validate the resulting structure and values before using them, especially when the data came from a request or file.
exercise: Encode two products as JSON, parse them and validate that each price is a finite number.
hint: A valid JSON document can still have the wrong fields for your app.

quiz.question: What does JSON.parse do?
options: Converts JSON text into a JavaScript value
quiz.explanation: Parsing converts the data representation. It does not execute code or validate your business rules.
